predictability.beta_tr_status: UNKNOWN: no forecast-residual bound in the sources used
predictability.assumption: All SEP excess is assigned to the unknown component; remaining excess in this diagnostic subsystem is trapped protons. For this subsystem all response-weighted trapped and SEP exposure is treated as an addition to a separately specified background. Physical bank background separation is not established.

LEO_51_6.models: AP8MIN with factor 2 already included; ESP/PSYCHIC, solar maximum, stormy magnetosphere, annual 95% design specification
LEO_51_6.ten_year_projection: Ten identical annual design blocks; both components scale by ten, ratio unchanged. Not a ten-year 95% quantile or a solar-cycle prediction.

rows.interval_basis: Monotonic integral spectrum: SEP(>35 MeV) <= SEP(>30 MeV) <= SEP(>25 MeV). No interpolation.

GUILD_graph_reading.models: AP9 v1.5 perturbed mean, 40 scenarios, 95th percentile; published one-week scaling to 10 years. ESP 10 years including 7 solar-maximum years; geomagnetic attenuation for LEO. Sum of percentiles is not a joint 95th percentile.
GUILD_graph_reading.method: Manual marker centres in the original embedded PNG, checked against full PDF pages. Interval includes centre reading uncertainty; not a statistical confidence interval. The near-overlapping SSO curves limit subtraction precision.

rows.note: Total marker partly occluded; wider reading interval.

GEO.trapped_upper_basis: INFERENCE limited to the published AP9 plot: the GEO integral curve exits below the plotted lower boundary before 10 MeV; integral fluence is nonincreasing. Conservative readout ceiling 1e4 cm^-2. This is not a bound on a physical unmodelled tail.
